# Invariant nested list result with an integer context

Independently authored Java8 declarations retain List<E>, a primitive int and
List<List<E>>. The frozen observer checks exact input/scalar values, size/get
and provider effects, partial runtime/Error identity, null results, nested
reference aliases, opaque result identity, ignored calls, delayed ArrayList
casts and the deprecated generic forwarding declaration. All source and SDK
output units compile with metadata, roles, Exceptions and helpers compared.
No private application bytes or behavior are included.
